title: Nothing hits worse than working on an edit and realizing you're missi...
description: Nothing hits worse than working on an edit and realizing you're missing footage. Your deadline is tomorrow with no time to reshoot. This is where @adobefirefly  comes in! Today I'm breaking down how I fill in my timeline gaps. And what I love about this as a long time Premiere Pro user, is that you can seamlessly go from Firefly& back to Premiere instantly. Happy creating! #adobepartner
